title: Native PG17 and PostgREST acceptance rehearsal
summary: Add pinned portable PG17.11/PostgREST16.5 loopback-only testing, full current schema checks and synthetic backup/restore.

changes.detail: Fixed portable PG17.11 profile and PostgREST16.5 archive verification; isolated credentials, no env-file or hosted targets. Test 13 RLS tables, constraints/indexes, role grants, JWT failures, concurrency and synthetic dump/restore.
Attempt local cluster shutdown after uncertain startup acknowledgement; preserve all databases and logs.

validation.name: Acceptance
validation.detail: Official archives downloaded; PostgREST publisher SHA256 matched and version command succeeds with PG libpq DLL path. Rehearsal pending; production remains NO-GO.
